source: Hand-mapped from the Hypixel SkyBlock Wiki's Bestiary family list against the mob ids a live profile reports under bestiary.kills.
note: The profile names mobs by internal id (unburried_zombie); the bestiary names families by display name (Crypt Ghoul). Nothing published joins them - the ids appear in no wiki page, no items resource and no resources endpoint. Three rules are structural and live in code (a trailing _<level>, a master_ prefix for master-mode dungeon mobs, a pest_ prefix for garden pests); everything below is named because it cannot be derived. A wrong entry credits kills to the wrong family, so the catalog cross-checks its result against the profile's own milestone count and reports how much of the bestiary it could account for.

noFamily.last_killed_mob: Not a kill count - the profile stores the last mob's name here.
noFamily.watcher: Dungeon boss. Bosses and their summons are killed, tracked, and never enter the bestiary.
noFamily.spirit_bat: Thorn's spirit mobs sit outside the bestiary.
